name: @example/dashboard-layout
title: Dashboard Layout
description: The one board that every dashboard page renders. Lays tiles out with @wippy-fe/layout and draws a frame around each tile.

wippy.description: The board that renders one dashboard page. It reads compiled page props, lays the tiles out with @wippy-fe/layout inside its shadow root, mounts each tile by tag, and draws a frame around each tile from the tile's render-state events (loading bar, source title and computed time, empty, denied, error and timeout states with a retry button). Pass the five attributes as JSON strings: sub-path, page-url, layout, tiles, params. The board scrolls when the page is taller than its container, and it picks the breakpoint from its own width. The same bundle also defines the dash-placeholder test tile.

sub-path.description: The path below the page's mount route, without the query.

page-url.description: Base URL of the page's endpoints, for example /api/v1/dashboards/pages/llm_usage.

layout.description: The breakpoints and layouts of the @wippy-fe/layout declaration. Panel ids are tile ids.

tiles.description: Map from tile id to its compiled form: tag, fields, options, data, actions, params, param, on.

params.description: Parameter declarations: type, label, default and optional from_path.
